searchText: I think you can add a margin Like 1k blocks margin is mlre than enough to be safe Bc even if you land on a missed slot, all you need is an extra block which will be guranteed to be far enough in the past Margin can actually be 1 1k is enough headroom for eventual engineering mistakes Wait but none of that should be a problem anyways If you keep 100k blocks that is equivalent to at LEAST 100k worth of slots history. You will reorg to a block way in the past worse case. But this is true regardless of history expiry or not
